name: FileUploadAll
description: Uploads file to a directory on the server.
syntax: FileUploadAll( string destination, [string accept], [string nameConflict], [boolean strict], [any allowedExtensions], [any blockedExtensions], [string strict], [string attributes], [object acl] )

params.name: destination
params.description: Absolute pathname of directory or file on web server.

params.name: accept
params.description:
Limits the MIME types to accept. Comma-delimited list. For example, to permit JPG and Microsoft Word file uploads:
accept = "image/jpg, application/msword"
The browser uses file extension to determine file type.

params.name: nameConflict
params.description:
Action to take if filename is the same as that of a file in the directory.

- skip
- error
- overwrite
- makeunique
- forceunique

params.name: strict
params.description: Applies only to Solaris and HP-UX. Permissions. Octal values of UNIX chmod command. Assigned to owner, group, and other, respectively.

params.name: allowedExtensions
params.description: String list or string array of allowed extensions.

params.name: blockedExtensions
params.description: String list or string array of not allowed extensions.

params.name: strict
params.description: Applies only to Solaris and HP-UX. Permissions. Octal values of UNIX chmod command. Assigned to owner, group, and other, respectively.

params.name: attributes
params.description:
One attribute (Windows) or a comma-delimited list of attributes (other platforms) to set on the file.
If omitted, the file's attributes are maintained.
